statuses.description: Takes magic damage every second until the flames die down.
Moves more slowly until it wears off. Only the strongest slow counts.
Can barely see: sight drops to 2 m, and it can't attack anything more than 3 m away.
Attacks faster: less time between swings, though each swing winds up as before. Only the strongest frenzy counts.
Unseen by enemies, who can't target it unless they detect it: a detector near it, or any of their units right beside it.
Can't be stealthed while it lasts. Attacking or casting from stealth reveals a unit for a short while.
